description: Stop posting this form's responses to an endpoint. Reversible in the sense that you can add the URL again, but the signing secret is gone — the new webhook gets a new one, and the receiving side has to be updated. Needs webhooks:manage.

form.description: Form id or hosted slug. A stable push handle also resolves on a login token; a project API key takes the id or slug.

name: fillo_remove_webhook
title: Remove a form's webhook
